description: Judge calibration set. Correct candidates use different words from the reference on purpose. Wrong candidates are fluent and specific but answer the question incorrectly.

items.label: correct
items.question: What is the maximum execution time for a single AWS Lambda invocation?
items.reference: A Lambda function can run for at most 15 minutes per invocation.
items.candidate: Each invocation is capped at 900 seconds, after which the runtime stops the function.

items.label: correct
items.question: Which API Gateway integration type passes the raw request to Lambda without a mapping template?
items.reference: Lambda proxy integration forwards the whole request to the function as an event and expects the function to shape the response.
items.candidate: Proxy integration. The function receives the complete request as its event object and must return the response format itself, with no mapping template in between.

items.label: correct
items.question: Does ECS on Fargate require you to manage EC2 instances?
items.reference: No. Fargate is serverless, so AWS provisions and manages the compute for each task.
items.candidate: No, with Fargate there are no instances to patch or scale; AWS runs the task compute for you.

items.label: correct
items.question: What causes a Lambda cold start?
items.reference: A cold start happens when Lambda must create a new execution environment before it can run the handler.
items.candidate: When no warm execution environment is available, Lambda initialises a fresh one, loads the runtime and your code, then runs the handler. That setup delay is the cold start, and provisioned concurrency avoids it.

items.label: wrong
items.question: What is the maximum execution time for a single AWS Lambda invocation?
items.reference: A Lambda function can run for at most 15 minutes per invocation.
items.candidate: A single invocation can run for up to 60 minutes before Lambda terminates it.

items.label: wrong
items.question: Which API Gateway integration type passes the raw request to Lambda without a mapping template?
items.reference: Lambda proxy integration forwards the whole request to the function as an event and expects the function to shape the response.
items.candidate: Custom (non-proxy) integration, which sends the request body straight to the function without any transformation.

items.label: wrong
items.question: Does ECS on Fargate require you to manage EC2 instances?
items.reference: No. Fargate is serverless, so AWS provisions and manages the compute for each task.
items.candidate: Yes. Fargate schedules tasks onto EC2 instances that you register into the cluster and keep patched.

items.label: wrong
items.question: What causes a Lambda cold start?
items.reference: A cold start happens when Lambda must create a new execution environment before it can run the handler.
items.candidate: Cold starts are caused by API Gateway throttling requests when the account-level rate limit is exceeded.
